purpose: Compare server-provided signal values and provenance at two snapshot instants for a locally selected vehicle.
primaryGoal: Identify changed signals, inspect numeric/non-numeric differences and source layers, filter, pin, export, save/share the comparison, and seed an alert rule.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: toNum and SignalDiffTable.asNumber repeat finite numeric/string/boolean coercion. Category/source panels repeat source loading/error/empty scaffolding.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: If touched, reuse one domain-level coercion helper preserving empty-string, boolean, non-finite and percentage semantics. Reuse existing feedback primitives; no speculative universal component.

observed: Compare windows stack below md; controls and category filters wrap.
Breakdown uses one column, md two columns, xl three columns.
Table wrapper is min-w-0/max-w-full; values and signal names remain whitespace-nowrap.
Bulk toolbar measures height and disables stickiness when taller than viewport.

findings.detail: mobileColumns keeps only name, delta and value_b. DataTable:724-725 hides the other columns below md. This caller supplies neither mobilePresentation nor an expanded-detail renderer, hiding Window A, both provenance/age badges and the row pin control on narrow screens.
findings.fix: Adopt existing DataTable mobile presentation/full-detail capability or a contained full-column strategy that keeps A/B values, provenance/ages and row pin actions reachable. Do not remove desktop virtualized selection.

responsive.runtime: unverified at all ten contract viewport widths, container widths, zoom, RTL and long content

observed: Datetime inputs have localized aria-labels; preset group uses useId and aria-labelledby.
Vehicle Select is wrapped in a native label, although the primitive introduces an internal div.
Table selection has explicit rowLabel; technical-column legend includes HelpTooltip names.
Breakdown section is named and decorative heading/empty-state icons are hidden from assistive technology.

findings.detail: Compact table fixes rowHeight at 36px; shared Select defaults to min-h-10 (Select.tsx:34). This is below the 44px stronger mobile target default, but actual hitboxes, spacing exceptions and table branch geometry were not measured.
findings.fix: Measure composed mobile controls and touch targets; use existing density/mobile target policy without losing table rows or pin access. Do not declare a WCAG failure from row height alone.

accessibility.runtime: keyboard, focus restoration, screen reader naming, reduced motion, forced colors and effective contrast unverified

observed: Diff fatal errors have retry in table and category/source panels; loading renders contextual skeletons.
Retained diff results survive refresh errors; StaleRefreshWarning and summary retained status are wired.
Diff metrics use null when initial/fatal or no response, preserving unknown versus measured zero.
Filtered empty table and breakdown clear-filter actions remain distinct from successful no-change result.
Independent pins and local snapshot-span metrics remain visible when diff is unavailable.

findings.detail: No-change branch requires zero rows, no filters and valid dates, but not a resolved diff response or positive vehicle. A disabled diff with valid defaults and vehicleId=0 can reach 'No signals changed' without a comparison. With invalid dates, the fallback table/breakdown also presents empty differences rather than input validation.
findings.fix: Require a successful available diff before asserting no changes; present existing unknown/unavailable and date validation states when comparison prerequisites are missing. Keep all panels and independent metrics.

findings.detail: Only data is consumed from vehicle and available-signal queries (also line 127). Their loading/failure/refresh states and retry are not rendered. A failed vehicle source can leave an empty picker and disabled diff; an unresolved catalog produces an empty signals CSV without its own explanatory trust state.
findings.fix: Retain each query object and expose source-specific loading/failure/retained/empty recovery using existing useDataState feedback. Preserve existing diff query behavior until empty-CSV backend semantics are verified.

findings.detail: Pinned breakdown receives only a Set; pending/fatal pin query defaults to an empty Set and is displayed as 'No pinned signals'. The KPI preserves null pin count, but the panel cannot distinguish failed/unloaded pins or show retained pin trust.
findings.fix: Extend the existing domain breakdown with pin DataState and retry, keeping successful empty pins separate from unavailable/loading and keeping retained pins visible. Do not make pin failure blank category/source neighbors.

states.runtime: unverified; no query, offline, paused-fetch, retained-cache or mutation state exercised

visualIssues.detail: SOURCE_META owns five hardcoded hex colors rather than a centralized semantic source-layer palette. Category bars already use chartTokens.series; labels use restrained cyan/amber and change direction uses emerald/rose. No neon/glow or fixed-white/gray class was found in the five scoped presentation files.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse existing semantic/chart palette ownership for layer colors while preserving source names, counts, ordering and user chart preferences. Measure themes/contrast before selecting exact tokens.

architectureIssues.detail: Selection state is never reconciled when vehicle/snapshot/filter scope changes. Bulk pin/unpin uses every selected name with the CURRENT vehicle context; CSV instead intersects selected names with current filtered rows. A carried selection can therefore affect pins for a different vehicle and disagree with exported selection scope.
architectureIssues.fix: Define and preserve same-scope selection semantics, clear/reconcile on vehicle or snapshot identity changes, and make selected-versus-visible export/action scope explicit. Keep stable signal row keys.

architectureIssues.detail: 'Before vs after last charge' computes now minus four hours and now; 'Last drive start vs end' computes now minus 90 minutes and five minutes. Neither derives an actual event. Existing behavior is a relative preset, not verified last-event evidence.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve relative offsets and query behavior; relabel/localize truthfully or integrate an existing verified event source under separate authorization. Do not invent event-backed instants.

architectureIssues.detail: Mounted App route is /signal-diff (App.tsx:738), while SavedViewMenu stores /telemetry/signal-diff. The latter is a saved-view persistence key, not a confirmed mounted alias. Renaming it cosmetically would strand existing views; tests also reference the older pathname.
architectureIssues.fix: Treat this exact persisted key as preservation-sensitive. Any canonicalization needs an explicit compatibility/migration plan in existing saved-view ownership; do not simply change the prop.

architectureIssues.detail: Bulk action says 'Copy CSV', but its implementation calls downloadCSV at line 232 and never copies to clipboard.
architectureIssues.fix: Align localized label with the existing selected CSV download; preserve filename and raw A/B/source columns.

architectureIssues.detail: Raw A/B numeric formatting uses the module-level fmtNumber, while delta uses useNumberFormatting. Rows lack unit-kind metadata and display raw signal values without units; SI values must not be guessed or blindly converted. The snapshot duration uses a local hardcoded h/m/s formatter (SignalDiffPage.tsx:58).
architectureIssues.fix: Keep raw wire/cache/export values and specialist coercion unchanged. Route numeric display through existing preference formatter; add SI-aware display only with verified catalog unit metadata, retaining raw evidence. Reuse an established duration formatter only if compact output equivalence is proved.

order: Prevent unavailable/disabled comparisons and unloaded pins from claiming successful empty evidence.
Preserve complete mobile provenance, A/B values and row pin access.
Make selected actions safe across vehicle/comparison scope changes.
Expose truthful relative presets and source-specific query recovery.
Consolidate source palette and preference-aware formatting without persistence or SI regressions.
